items.source: in favor of implementing Decoder.decode(DataBuffer, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) instead
items.translation: 支持实现 `Decoder.decode(DataBuffer, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)` 而不是

items.source: Sub-classes must implement decodeDataBuffer(DataBuffer, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) to provide a way to transform a DataBuffer to the target data type. The default decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) implementation transforms each individual data buffer while decodeToMono(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) applies "reduce" and transforms the aggregated buffer.
items.translation: 子类必须实现decodeDataBuffer(DataBuffer, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)，以提供一种将DataBuffer转换为目标数据类型的方法。默认的decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)实现会转换每个单独的数据缓冲区，而decodeToMono(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)则应用“归约”操作并转换聚合后的缓冲区。

items.source: Sub-classes can override decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map) in order to split the input stream along different boundaries (for example, on new line characters for String) or always reduce to a single data buffer (for example, Resource).
items.translation: 子类可以重写decode(Publisher, ResolvableType, MimeType, Map)，以便按照不同的边界拆分输入流（例如，对于String按换行符拆分），或者始终缩减为单个数据缓冲区（例如，Resource）。
